source_note: Fixed (world) lodestones: BP_WorldLodestone_C actors in the World Partition cells of /Game/Maps/World/L_World (GameplayObjectRegistryIdentifier, baked per actor and the same in every world; DefaultSceneRoot location). First datamined from RSDWArchive 1.0.2.0 (Content/Maps/World/L_World/_Generated_/<cell>.json), then confirmed from an installed copy of the game (see install_check). Cross-checked with the wiki Lodestone page map (4 permanent locations) and with two world saves (ids match; for the 3 registered ones "location" is the exact double the game wrote, which equals the install value, so an activation writes the same bytes; Umbral Sands is not yet seen in a save and uses the install value). Player-built lodestones (BP_BaseBuilding_Lodestone_C) get a random id per placement and are not catalogued. See docs/research/lodestones.md.

install_check.confirmed_from_install: id, actor, cell, tags and location of all 4 (the install has exactly 4 BP_WorldLodestone_C actors); locations equal the install's doubles exactly
install_check.changed_after_install_check: Umbral Sands location was a rounded datamine value (max 0.008 uu off); replaced with the install's exact doubles
install_check.not_confirmed_from_install: name and area (wiki, map region polygons) and spud_level (world saves)

lodestones.name: Temple of Saradomin
lodestones.note: Starting-area lodestone (wiki: 'Lodestone (Inactive)'); registered even in a world with no built lodestones.

lodestones.name: Death's Domain
lodestones.note: Wiki name 'Death's Domain'; the map region polygon at this point is Forgotten Temple.

lodestones.name: Dowdun Reach Entrance
lodestones.note: Region polygons for The Approach and The Courtyard overlap here; the wiki says The Approach.

lodestones.name: Umbral Sands
lodestones.note: Not registered in either sample world (not yet seen in a save); id, actor, cell, tags and location confirmed from the installed game.

storage.scope: per-world (shared by every character in that world); nothing in the character JSON

registry.file: SaveGames/<world>.sav (also mirrored in Saved/SpudCache/L_World.lvl while a world is loaded)
registry.layout: u32 count, then per entry UE5 tagged properties until 'None': Location (StructProperty Vector_NetQuantize: X,Y,Z DoubleProperty), RespawnLocation (same; Z = Location.Z + 145), Identifier (StructProperty Guid, 16 bytes)
registry.meaning: the set of lodestones usable as teleport targets; the map UI teleports by Identifier (log: HandleLodestoneIconClicked ... Lodestone with ID <Identifier>)

world_actor.note: no activated/repaired flag; only exists in the save for cells that have been streamed and saved

storage.character: none: GameProgress.ActorsInteractedWith is a class-name list the game discards on load (log warning); no lodestone keys
